name: model-council
description: Consult other LLMs as tools — ask them, compare their answers, synthesize a conclusion.
long_description:
Seats other LLMs at your table as tools, so your assistant can ask them, relay their answers back and forth for critique, and give you one merged conclusion — inside a single conversation, with no copy-paste.

The form below configures two seats, which is the smallest council worth having. Each takes an endpoint, a key, a model id, and which wire format that endpoint speaks: `openai` for anything OpenAI-compatible, `anthropic` for the Messages format. Setting the URL of an Anthropic-style endpoint without also setting the format is the one mistake that reliably breaks a seat.

For more than two members, or for several models sharing one endpoint and one key, point "Config file" at a JSON config instead; it takes precedence over the fields above. The project README documents its shape.

first_base_url.title: First model — endpoint
first_base_url.description: Root URL the API hangs off, usually ending in /v1 for OpenAI-compatible hosts. For an Anthropic-format endpoint, leave the /v1 off.

first_api_key.title: First model — API key
first_api_key.description: Stored by the app, not written into a config file.

first_model.title: First model — model id
first_model.description: The id sent to that endpoint, e.g. gpt-5. Ask the assistant to run probe_models later if you are unsure what the endpoint offers.

first_format.title: First model — wire format
first_format.description: openai for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, anthropic for the Anthropic Messages format.

second_base_url.title: Second model — endpoint
second_base_url.description: Leave the second seat empty to start with one model; it will simply report as not configured.

second_api_key.title: Second model — API key
second_api_key.description: Stored by the app, not written into a config file.

second_model.title: Second model — model id
second_model.description: The id sent to that endpoint, e.g. glm-4.6.

council_models.title: Seats to enable
council_models.description: Comma-separated ids of the seats to seat. Leave as is for both; set to just 'first' if you are only using one.

config_file.title: Config file (optional)
config_file.description: A JSON config, for councils larger than two or for several models sharing one endpoint. Takes precedence over the fields above. See the project README for its shape.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask one member of the council a question.

tools.name: ask_all
tools.description: Ask several members the same prompt in parallel.

tools.name: list_council
tools.description: List the members, their endpoints, and whether each is ready.

tools.name: probe_models
tools.description: Ask an endpoint which model ids it actually exposes.
